title: Broken bone (fracture)
scenario: Possible broken arm, leg, wrist, or ankle. Snap felt or heard, limb looks bent or deformed, severe pain, swelling, cannot put weight on it.
steps: Keep it still. Do not move the injured limb more than necessary.
Support the limb in the position you found it, using a rolled towel, magazine splint, or sling, padded with cloth.
Apply a cold pack wrapped in cloth to reduce swelling — not directly on skin.
Call 911 if the limb is badly deformed, bone is visible, the person cannot be moved safely, there is numbness or bluish color, or a head, neck, or back injury is suspected.
Otherwise get to medical care as soon as it is safe to travel.
do_not: Do not straighten the limb or push a bone back in.
Do not move someone with a suspected neck or back injury unless they are in immediate danger.
